pyramiding_rule: Zero averaging down; only add to winning positions when price crosses a 1.5 ATR threshold in favor with trailing stops locked to breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a volume delta confirmation and a 5-period EMA slope alignment before executing any market order to filter out false breakout wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stops once floating profit hits $8.00 to force capture toward the $15-$30 asymmetric target band.
